verdict.rationale: Crossplane's core model is a control plane that reconciles continuously in the background. You configure a pipeline of composition functions instead of writing a controller, and the control plane automatically corrects drift from desired state. Community users corroborate this, describing active controllers that react to failures and a running control plane for enforcement. The automation is limited to declarative resource reconciliation, not general-purpose tasks. Missing for 10: scheduled or cron-style and event-triggered arbitrary automations, any AI- or agent-driven background tasks, and in-depth docs on background operation and monitoring.
